# Planned Outage: Assets API - September 23, 2025 at 4:30 PM PST

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**jessicamoll** (9/16/2025):

There will be a planned outage affecting the Assets API due to a scheduled security upgrade.

* Date: Tuesday September 23, 2025
* Time: 4:30 PM PST
* Expected Duration: approximately 1 hour
* Affected Services: Assets API (other services will remain operational)

Thank you for your cooperation.
